verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a payroll and HR SaaS, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no retention settings, deletion endpoints or data-deletion workflows. The nearby items are adjacent controls only: the MCP server lets users pick which data categories an LLM can access, and the CLI has a telemetry opt-out. Neither is retention or deletion control, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
